title: confed fetch result
description: The `result` of `confed fetch --json`. fetch only updates .state.db; it never writes a page file.

unchanged.description: Pages already at the server's version.

deleted_on_remote.description: Page ids that disappeared from the space listing.

failed.description: Pages that could not be fetched, or whose comments could not be read. Non-empty means exit 8.

resumed.description: True when an interrupted fetch was continued rather than restarted.

comments_refreshed.description: Pages at an unchanged version whose comments were read again. A comment has a version of its own: adding or editing one does not change the page's.

comments_changed.description: Of those, the page ids whose comments had changed. `confed pull` writes them to comments.md.

comment_check_failed.description: Present when the server could not be asked which comments changed, with the reason. Comments of unchanged pages may then be out of date; the same is in `warnings`.
